dct_description_sm: The objective of this project was the identification of climate change impacts and adaptation measures by the community based members and organizations of the Fur Institute of Canada (FIC). The project provided the opportunity to build on the land based presence of FIC Aboriginal/Inuit members and the national network of FIC community based organizations across northern Canada to directly engage Aboriginal and Inuit communities in the community driven identification of climate change impacts, the development of adaptive capacity and the implementation of adaptive measures.
